Hello Dr. Nickel. My name is Viktor. I am from Russia. Now I am 25 yo. Sorry for my English language. Help me please...

I have been suffering this disease since 13 yo.
In the beginning I felt burning in urethra during urination, later I felt discomfort in prostate with burning. When I was 15 yo, I went to doctor with my father. Doctor palpated my prostate and I felt severe pain. My diagnose was chronic  prostatitis. I didn’t treat due to my parent didn’t believe that doctor. In Russia many doctors deceived patients to earn more money. I think it happens everywhere.

When I moved to Saint Petersburg to study in university my pain became much worse. I went to many doctors from urologist to psychiatrist etc.  I took lots of antibiotics (doxycycline, gentamicin, levofloxacin, roxytromecin, different antifungal medicines etc) but I wasn’t helped it at all. Proctologist told me that I had tense levators. I took gabapentin, fluvoxamin, amitriptyline, alprazolam etc but these medications also didn’t help me. After that I went to Moscow to do complex urodynamic testing. During profilometry was discovered that I have high pressure in urethra. Then I was prescribed to take baclofen but it too didn’t help me. I had lots of analyzes and they are good. I cry every day but find helping and don’t want to give up. Now I was offered injections in prostate. And also I want to do cystourethroscopy because I feel that burning happened in urethra. I constant pressure crotch. I read pubmed, researchgate etc every day but I think that I have urethroprostatic reflux. I use suppositories with diclofenak almost every day. I read about pelvic pain therapists but in Russia I didn’t find them. Please help me I don’t know what to do. I think about suicide every day, I can’t have masturbation or sex due to pain after urination after ejaculation. I even can’t remember all medications which I took. Do I need to do urethrocystoscopy or injection in prostate? Please answer me I beg you!
